title: ResaleSearch stage is loading + loaded + error + request_id
trigger: Open a gift's resale list, change a filter, scroll for more.
effect: loading/loaded/error are independent; request_id is a bare u64 and 0 means none; a failed load-more sets loaded=true with error and keeps next_offset.
fix: enum SearchStage { Idle, Loading { request: RequestId, page }, Ready, Failed(String) } inside the search.

title: ResaleBuy purchase stage is sending + done + request + price_changed
trigger: Buy a listing, answer arrives or the price changed.
effect: sending, done (set then the whole buy is dropped on the same line, so never read), request (0 = none) and price_changed are kept in step by hand.
fix: enum BuyStage { View, Send, Confirm, Paying { request: RequestId }, Repriced(GiftPrice) }; drop done.

title: CraftSession stage is candidates_loading/loaded/request plus crafting/craft_request/result
trigger: Open the craft box, load candidates, craft, close.
effect: Two parallel lifecycles (candidate paging and the craft itself) each use a bool plus a bare u64 request id and an Option result.
fix: Fetch<Candidates> and enum CraftStage { Choosing, Crafting(RequestId), Done(CraftResult) }.

title: Auction open is auction_request + auction_loading + auction_ready (+ GiftMarketUi::pending_auction + bidding)
trigger: Tap an auction tile or link, then another before the first answers; place a bid.
effect: Four fields across Session and UI must change together; bidding is a bare Option<i64> not tied to a request id.
fix: One enum AuctionOpen { Idle, Loading { request }, Ready(gift_id) } and Bid { Idle, Placing { request, gift_id } }.

title: CraftSession candidates kept as candidates_loading + candidates_loaded + candidates_request
trigger: n/a
effect: Two bools and a request id describe one fetch; the error arm sets loaded=true so a failed load reads as 'no gifts of yours' in the select box (the toast is the only error signal).
fix: `candidates: Fetch<Page<CraftGift>>` carrying its request id.

title: Craft lists loading stage as candidates_loading/candidates_loaded/candidates_offset and market.loading/loaded
trigger: Open Select Gifts.
effect: Select box reads loading and loaded flags separately (craft_select_box) to pick spinner, empty or list.
fix: Fetch<T> per list.

title: Forge stage is spread over forge_started, CraftSession::crafting, craft_request and result
trigger: Press Craft.
effect: Forge ends only when upkeep sees forge_started elapsed and crafting==false; the stage is inferred from four fields in two owners.
fix: enum Forge { Idle, Waiting{request, since}, Answered(CraftResult) } on CraftSession.

title: Craft progress split across UI forge_started, session crafting/craft_request and result
trigger: n/a
effect: Four values (GiftMarketUi::forge_started, CraftSession::crafting, craft_request, result) must agree by hand; craft_frame_upkeep infers the stage from their combination, and market_replace(CraftResult) replaces whatever box is on top at the time.
fix: One `CraftStage` enum on CraftSession (Editing, Forging{request, started}, Done(result)); the forge's minimum time is data of Forging.

title: ResaleBuy step + sending + price_changed + pay_in_grams
trigger: Buy view/send/confirm steps, a sending bool and a price_changed Option are changed by set_buy_step/set_buy_grams and the reducer.
effect: sending is a stage flag next to step; price_changed is cleared by hand in set_buy_grams.
fix: BuyStep with Sending{request} and PriceChanged{new} variants.

title: Process-wide CACHE + GENERATION + REFRESHING (+ the UI's WATCHING flag) form a fetch stage kept by hand
trigger: n/a (Settings > System draws state(); a stale answer starts a thread; the UI polls refreshing() every 100 ms)
effect: No bug found: RefreshDone clears REFRESHING on panic and spawn failure. A read that never returns (wedged xdg-mime/registry without the timeout) would leave REFRESHING true forever.
fix: One Fetch<LinkHandlerState> cell with Idle/Loading{gen}/Ready/Stale.

title: CommentsTracker keeps state, has, last_id and last_read_id in step by hand
trigger: n/a (new comments, toggle, pinned-comment click)
effect: No bug on the main paths; set_has returns early when has is unchanged so state is only corrected by the next change.
fix: Fold has into CommentsState (Shown{..}, Hidden{unread: bool}, Empty) so one value carries the stage.

title: Address lookup stage is resolving_for, job, postponed, hidden_while_moving, shown_once and moving
trigger: drag the pin, release, wait for the address, drag again
effect: none today; the address shown depends on which of five fields is set
fix: An enum Address { Hidden, Postponed(point), Resolving(point), Shown{point,text}, HiddenWhileMoving{point,text} } owned by the picker, with moving as part of the pin state.

title: VenueSearch stage is list (VenueList) plus needs_send, debounce and request kept in step by hand; Address is resolving_for/postponed/job/hidden_while_moving; moving and places_in_area are separate bools
trigger: n/a (every pan, zoom, search keystroke and answer edits several of them)
effect: No bug today; a request in flight is only 'needs_send == false && list == Loading'.
fix: One enum per concern: VenueQuery { Idle, Waiting(debounce), ToSend, InFlight(generation), Done } and AddressState { Hidden, Postponed(p), Resolving(p), Shown(text) }.

title: Venue search stage is five fields kept in step by hand
trigger: open picker, type in the search field, pause, close search, move the map
effect: none today; stage is spread over needs_send, debounce, search_shown, generation, request and list
fix: One enum for the venue query: Idle, Debouncing{query}, Wanted{generation,point,query}, InFlight{generation,..}, Answered, Failed; list derived from it.

title: Space-hold boost is pressed_at, last_seen and active kept together
trigger: Hold Space in the media viewer video, or lose the key-up to another window
effect: none today (stale press is timed out and cancel clears it)
fix: enum Boost { Idle, Armed{since,last_seen}, Boosting{last_seen} }.

title: One trackpad gesture is tracked by two machines (SwipeNav::gesture and WheelNav accum plus spent_at) handed off by a returned bool
trigger: n/a: ui/media_viewer/navigation.rs viewer_scroll_wheel runs viewer_swipe first and skips WheelNav when it returns true, so WheelNav::spent_at and SwipeNav::gesture must agree on when a gesture started, ended or moved an item.
effect: No bug today; WheelNav::spent_at (an Option used as a 'gesture already moved' flag) is not refreshed for captured events, and the two must be reset together by new_item() on every item change and by nothing on viewer close.
fix: One TrackpadGesture enum (Idle, Undecided, Swiping, Scrolling, Spent, Released) owned by the viewer that both the swipe and the scroll step read.

title: A message's effect stage (unwatched, watched, unknown) is two key sets kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a: note(), renamed() and mark_watched() consult `watched` and `unwatched` together; renamed() moves only unwatched, and a key's stage is the combination of two memberships.
effect: Both sets are cleared independently when full (BoundedKeys::insert), so a stage can silently revert to unknown and a message can replay or never play.
fix: HashMap<MessageKey, EffectStage> with Unwatched and Watched variants and one eviction policy.

title: Per-effect fetch stage is spread over by_id, requested and failed
trigger: n/a: accept(), fail() and mark_requested() each have to remove the id from the other sets by hand.
effect: An id can be in requested and failed, or in by_id and failed, if a writer is added that forgets one removal; wanted() has to test all three.
fix: HashMap<i64, Fetch<MessageEffect>> (src/state/fetch.rs) as the single record per effect id.

title: Media file stage in MediaFacts is downloading and local bools plus Option<bool> tri-states
trigger: n/a: menu_media_facts (ui/message_menu_ui/mod.rs:208) builds downloading and local from two unrelated lookups, so both can be true (a re-download of a local file); media_actions then offers only Cancel Download and hides Show in Folder and Save As.
effect: The menu for a file that is on disk and being fetched again offers only Cancel Download; the favorite, gif_saved and in_profile Options mean 'unknown until loaded' beside a bool, a second pair of states.
fix: A MediaFile enum (Remote, Downloading, Local) and a Known<bool> for the loaded-later facts, built once from the session's file record.

title: Widget crash streak lives in a counter beside Lifecycle
trigger: A widget stops repeatedly (CPU/memory/validator limit)
effect: Whether a Stopped widget restarts depends on WidgetEntry::crashes (reset in widgets_ui.rs at content change and first frame, bumped on stop) and on runtime.is_none() in widget_bubble.rs, not on the Lifecycle value alone
fix: Lifecycle::Stopped{reason, streak: u8} and Lifecycle::GaveUp{reason}, so the streak resets when the variant changes.

title: WidgetEntry keeps the runtime's stage in `lifecycle` and its per-runtime data in separate fields reset by hand
trigger: Read start_widget, the Stopped/Failed arm of widget_event, the release in start_waiting_widgets and the identity change in reconcile_widgets: each sets runtime, lifecycle, queries, theme, wants_frames, crashes, polled by hand, and each resets a different subset (pressed, hold, hovered, selection, cursor, frame and queries are left behind by some).
effect: No user-visible bug by itself today; it is how P3 widget findings (stale press, stale frame after a content change) arise.
fix: Carry the runtime and everything that belongs to it in the live variants: `Lifecycle::Loading(Live) | Running(Live)` with `Live { runtime, queries, theme, wants_frames, cursor, press: Option<Press> }`, so a stop, release or restart drops all of it at once.

title: Widget on-screen state is `visible: bool` plus `hidden_at` (0 while visible) plus `window`/`view`, kept in step by hand
trigger: hide_widgets sets visible=false and hidden_at=clock; reconcile_widgets sets visible=true and hidden_at=0; widgets_left_window moves window/view without touching the others.
effect: No bug found from this pairing alone.
fix: `enum Placement { Shown { window: Option<ChatId>, view: Option<EntityId>, width: f32 }, Hidden { since: u64 } }`.

title: `WidgetsUi::landing: bool` marks a detached landing loop as started
trigger: watch_widget_runtimes sets landing with mem::replace and detaches the spawn_screen task; nothing clears the flag, the loop ends only when the screen is replaced (which replaces the flag too).
effect: No bug today because WidgetsUi lives in OnScreen; a future owner change (or any other exit from the loop) would leave landing true and no frames or events would ever land again.
fix: Store the task: `landing: Option<Task<()>>`, so the loop's existence and the flag are one value and dropping the owner cancels it.

title: Signal handler stage is IN_HANDLER + REPORT_DONE + INSTALLED atomics
trigger: A fault in one thread while another faults
effect: Works today (first thread writes, others wait up to 2 s); stage is three separate bools
fix: One AtomicU8 with Idle, Reporting, Reported.

title: Coalesce is a dirty + running pair of atomics that must change together
trigger: Windows network change delivers dozens of callbacks on system threads
effect: Correct today (the loop re-checks dirty after clearing running); the stage is encoded by two bools instead of Idle/Running/RunningDirty
fix: A single AtomicU8 with states Idle, Running, RunningDirty and compare_exchange transitions.

title: NewChatStage::Type.saving: Option<Vec<RequestId>> is a 'save attempted' flag cleared by hand
trigger: Type step: Save sends requests (saving=Some), a refusal is read from groups.info_edit_errors[chat] (keyed by chat, field Username, not by request); typing in the link field sets saving=None via new_chat_link_edited
effect: A refusal from a save that is not the one in flight is shown for the current one, and a save whose requests all vanished without an answer moves on to Subscribers as if it succeeded
fix: Type{chat, save: TypeSave} with TypeSave::{Editing, Saving(requests), Refused(reason)}; match the refusal by request id.

title: StageFacts mirrors request liveness as bools next to the NewChatStage enum
trigger: New Group/Channel flow: create_pending, type_pending, type_failed and outcome are derived from Session.requests and info_edit_errors on each draw and combined with NewChatStage by view()
effect: Stage and facts can disagree (Creating with no outcome and no live request shows the back step unbusy; Type{saving:Some} with a request that vanished goes straight to Subscribers as if the save succeeded)
fix: Put the request state in the stage: Creating{request, state: Fetch<ChatId>} and Type{saving: Saving{requests, state: InFlight|Failed(reason)|Done}} updated by the answer, instead of re-deriving it from the session.

title: Background unread is a process-global atomic written by the UI at several call sites
trigger: Account switch, retire_live_to_background, take_background_live, poll, stop_background_clients each call publish_background_unread
effect: A path that changes background clients without calling publish_background_unread leaves the tray, dock badge and window title with the old other-accounts count (also read without an owner key by window_chrome.rs)
fix: Derive the badge from BackgroundAccounts::total_unread when drawing, or make the clients list the single writer through a setter that publishes.

title: BackgroundAccounts keeps the lifecycle of each account in several sets, counters and bools
trigger: Starting, closing, removing, wiping or restarting accounts.
effect: starting (set), preparing (counts), closing (ClosingSet), deleting (set), clients (Vec with live Option and status), plus polling, wiping, swept and screen_preparing are all read together in ensure_background_accounts, deletion_wait, open_wait and startup_sweep. An account's stage (Preparing, Starting, Running, Closing, Deleting, Failed) is the combination of its membership in these. The polling bool is also the 'a poll task runs' flag.
fix: HashMap<AccountKey, AccountStage> with an enum (Preparing, Starting, Running(LiveConnect), Closing{restart}, Deleting, NeedsSignIn/Failed) so every check is one match; polling as Option<Task>.

title: A background account that failed to start keeps a dead client entry that nothing retries
trigger: finish_background_start gets a non-DiskFull blocker (keychain read fails once) or the bridge stops unexpectedly.
effect: The entry stays with live None and status Failed; ensure_background_accounts skips any key that has a client entry, so the account gets no notifications or unread count until Quill restarts or the account is switched to.
fix: Make Failed a stage with a retry exit (on the next ensure pass or an explicit retry), instead of an entry that blocks the start.

title: Do Not Disturb probe is three process-wide atomics (DND, CHECKED_AT_MS, REFRESHING)
trigger: Any alert decision calls dnd_active(); a stale answer starts a worker.
effect: No bug today: REFRESHING is cleared by a drop guard even on panic. The answer is false until the first refresh lands, so the very first notification after start in Do Not Disturb may still play (warm() mitigates).
fix: One Mutex<enum Dnd { Unknown, Known{on,at}, Refreshing{last} }>.

title: Paid reaction picker state is single-slot Options not tied to an owner (offered, senders, note)
trigger: Open the message reaction menu on message A in the main window and on message B in a chat window; open the Star box in two chats in turn.
effect: `offered` holds one (chat,message) for the whole account, `senders` holds the channels of one chat only (fetching for chat B drops A's, and the request is not tracked in flight, so re-opening re-asks), and `note` is a free-text last refusal that is only cleared by the next successful add.
fix: Move offered into the per-chat reaction menu state (ChatUi), make senders a map of Fetch<Vec<i64>> per chat, and make note part of the toast value.

title: Passkey sign-in stage is config_requested, pending, ceremony, checking and error
trigger: QR sign-in screen: link click, options fetch, ceremony, checkAuthenticationPasskey.
effect: `checking: bool` is set before the request and cleared only by ok/fail/send error; a dropped request or an auth state that moves on by itself leaves it true until the next fail(). `config_requested` is a once-only flag kept on a Session that survives logout.
fix: enum LoginStage { Idle, FetchingOptions(request), Ceremony(options), Checking(request), Failed(String) } reset whole when the authorization state leaves the QR screen.

title: PasskeysState spreads the list fetch, removal and registration over eight fields
trigger: known/stale/requested_at drive the fetch; removing/error drive removal; registration/ceremony/adding/added drive the add flow; error is shared by all three.
effect: A failed removal and a failed list share one `error` string; `added` is a one-shot flag the UI takes; `ceremony` and `registration` hold the same options twice.
fix: List: Fetch<Vec<Passkey>> with a stale generation; removal: Option<Removal{id, request}> in the list value; registration: one enum (see 04-p2-010) with its own error.

title: Passkey registration: adding bool, registration, ceremony and added one-shot
trigger: n/a
effect: adding is set in finish_register and cleared by the Add error arm or accept_added; the Parameters error arm leaves registration/ceremony as they were.
fix: enum Registration { Idle, FetchingOptions, Ceremony(opts), Adding, Added }.

title: CeremonyUi keeps sheet, worker handle, qr and focus_pin in step by hand
trigger: Any ceremony event (Hybrid, PhoneConnecting, Failed, UseKey).
effect: sheet and ceremony: Option<Ceremony> and qr must change together (Failed sets sheet=Error, ceremony=None, qr=None; set_ceremony_sheet clears qr); focus_pin is a one-shot flag; the dialog open predicate also excludes Probing, so the ceremony can be running with no dialog and no way to cancel.
fix: Make each CeremonySheet variant own what it needs (Choose{qr}, Pin{invalid,focus}, Running{ceremony}) so the worker handle lives only in running sheets.

title: Passkey ticker is an Option<Task> used as a started flag
trigger: Create Passkey / Log in using passkey; lock; finish.
effect: ticker.is_some() means running; cleared by the task itself at its end and by the lock; busy is derived from ceremony + driver adding/ceremony/login state, a second copy of the stage.
fix: One PasskeyFlow enum in the owner with the ticker task inside the busy variants.

title: FreeState requesting + serial + menu_open are a request stage plus a menu stage
trigger: Click the pill, open the menu while a request is on its way, account price changes
effect: requesting, serial and menu_open are reset by hand in request, drop_pending, sync and pill_clicked
fix: enum FreeUi { Idle, MenuOpen, Requesting{request,serial} } so a request closes the menu by construction.

title: contact_link Fetch is paired with a separate contact_error Option
trigger: getUserLink for the contact link fails
effect: UserLinkFetch::Failed and contact_error are set together and cleared separately (retry_contact_link, drain_peer_qr take()); Failed with no error or error with no Failed can occur
fix: UserLinkFetch::Failed(Option<String>) with the box taking the reason once (Fetch<T> shape).

title: PeerQrBox save stage is chosen + saving + failed + save_serial + served kept in step by hand
trigger: Pick, close panel, save, fail, pick again, rights change
effect: chosen/saving/failed/served move together in apply(); a missed arm leaves a pick unsaved or resent
fix: One enum Theme { Following(served), Picked(choice), Saving{serial,choice}, SaveFailed(choice) } with the transitions in one place.

title: PanelMotion keeps shown, opening and started in step with the reducer's panel
trigger: Open and close the colors panel.
effect: Three fields describe one animation (idle, opening, closing) beside QrPanel in the reducer; qr_act rebuilds them whenever panel changes, and started is never cleared after the motion ends.
fix: enum PanelMotion { Idle, Opening{panel,since}, Closing{panel,since} } derived from the reducer's panel change.

title: QR box export and clock stages are two bools on OpenQr
trigger: Open the QR box with a countdown, press Copy or Share.
effect: exporting (set in export.rs qr_export, cleared in the continuation only when the box id matches) and clock_running (set in sync_qr_clock, cleared by the loop) are hand-kept stage flags; a dropped continuation leaves exporting true and the Copy button spinning.
fix: enum Export { Idle, Rendering, ShareReady(PathBuf) } and enum Clock { Stopped, Running } (or a task handle) on OpenQr.
